builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Brand: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (1,080 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 52.4% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A combo mage who sequences Blaze stacks and punishes enemies clustered around burning targets. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Morellonomicon. Deathfire Touch keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Zhonya's Hourglass.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Morellonomicon, with Deathfire Touch.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Morellonomicon) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 52.4% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Morellonomicon.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing [2]% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3329999446868896, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 18, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times.

When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing [(characterLevelInterpolation(6 → 12; raw flags preserved) + (0.02) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Units that are Ablaze take [(75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP) × (1.25)] damage instead.

Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage to surrounding units.

If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.

Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing [100 / 175 / 250 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions.

If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by [30 / 45 / 60]%.

Brand launches a fireball that deals [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for [1.75] seconds.

builds.name: Detonation Ally Mark
builds.summary: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay.
builds.goal: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay.
builds.hypothesis: Three Blaze stacks explode after two seconds and apply spell effects. Q stuns an already Ablaze target, allowing Mandate vulnerability before the delayed explosion and allied follow-up. Rylai tests retention; Blackfire benefits from actual spread.
testPlan: Required state: Apply Blaze before Q and complete three stacks with an ally nearby.
Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed Q or spread targets prevent the overlap.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Blaze slow alone is not Mandate immobilization.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Imperial Mandate, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Blackfire Torch, Cryptbloom, Rabadon's Deathcap, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Brand: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A combo mage who sequences Blaze stacks and punishes enemies clustered around burning targets. Compare Blaze detonation on isolated versus clustered targets. Burn refresh, passive explosion and R bounce geometry must be measured instead of independently stacking every tick. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Brand: Compare Blaze detonation on isolated versus clustered targets. Burn refresh, passive explosion and R bounce geometry must be measured instead of independently stacking every tick.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Brand's stated kit question: Compare Blaze detonation on isolated versus clustered targets. Burn refresh, passive explosion and R bounce geometry must be measured instead of independently stacking every tick.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.summary: Record every R recipient while varying Brand distance.
builds.goal: Record every R recipient while varying Brand distance.
builds.hypothesis: R can bounce to Brand and prioritizes Blaze stacking; E doubles spread on Ablaze. Riftmaker can ramp through sustained combat, Cosmic repositions the bounce anchor and Zhonya tests pressure survival. Shadowflame affects qualifying low-health magic packets.
testPlan: Required state: Stay within bounce spacing with enough health to survive.
Record every R recipient while varying Brand distance; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

failureConditions: Retreat strands bounces or stasis changes routing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Five bounces are not five hits on one champion.
